from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceEntry(BaseModel):
    """A cash balance line item extracted from a financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the line item as written in the document")
    amount_str: str | None = Field(description="The amount including units (e.g. $2,597 thousand)")
    balance_date: str | None = Field(description="The date associated with this balance (e.g. beginning or end of period)")
    statement_name: str | None = Field(description="The financial statement this line appears in (e.g. Balance Sheet)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalanceEntry]
